Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to get Redwood live. Attached is our official PO (88921) for the first year. A few items we need to make sure are handled on your side before we can kick off invoicing: 

- We need Redwood to accept PO number 88921 on invoices for PO-matching in our system.
- Vendor registration: our AP portal requires a vendor remit address + VAT/Tax ID (we operate in the US but will need VAT capture later for EEA billing).

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending the PO and context. Welcome aboard.

Quick answers up front:
- Yes, we will include PO 88921 on all invoices for this engagement.
- We can accept a two-week invoice submission grace period as long as the invoice date and PO number are present; our finance team will queue payments to your remit instructions once the vendor record is fully created.
- For vendor onboarding, please either (a) upload to your supplier portal (preferred) or (b) send the completed vendor registration form to rachel_kim@redwood.ai.

Rachel — looping you in to accept the PO and send the Redwood vendor registration checklist. Ben, FYI on timing — Orchid asked about possible early-pay options later; let's flag that for FinOps.

Jordan Blake

Hi Sarah — thanks, we received the PO and started vendor setup. Steps / notes: 

1) Vendor record required fields (please provide within 48 hours):
   - Legal business name
   - Remit address (line1, city, state, country, postal code)
   - W-9 (for US tax) or W-8 (if applicable)
   - VAT/GST ID (we have a field for future EEA invoicing)

2) How to submit: either upload to your portal referencing Redwood Inference (Vendor ID pending) OR send the completed Orchid_vendor_registration_form.xlsx to me. I have attached a blank copy for convenience.

3) PO acceptance & invoice format:
   - We will accept PO 88921 as long as the invoice includes the header: PO: 88921 and our billing address.
   - Please put line-level breakdowns (SaaS license, support hours, usage credits) and the invoice number. PDF preferred.

4) Grace period & payment schedule:
   - We can accommodate a two-week invoice submission grace period for initial onboarding. Important: payment terms remain Net 30 from invoice date unless you opt into our early-pay program.
   - If Orchid wants early pay (Net 10 / 1.5% fee or variable discount), we can enroll after the first invoice clears; ping Ben and FinOps.

5) VAT handling:
   - For now, invoices to Redwood US entities should not include VAT. If Orchid later invoices an EU entity or needs reverse-charge processing, we will request VAT ID + relevant tax forms prior to payment.

Attachments: [Attachment: Orchid_vendor_registration_form.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]

If you upload the documents, please reply with the portal reference ID and I will confirm once the vendor record is active.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Manager, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
[rachel_kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0233]
